settings.label: Our Story · Tomah to Waterloo, WI
settings.title: Built in Wisconsin. Built to pull.
settings.lede: It started in 2014 with one idea. That idea became a Pro Stock tractor, built by a family in its own shop. And that tractor was nicknamed “The Evil One”.

settings.place: A real track, a short run

settings.title: The name was never up for debate
settings.text: Chris, a lifelong heavy metal fan, decided to build a Pro Stock pulling tractor. The name picked itself, and so did the nickname: “The Evil One”.

settings.title: Built nights and weekends
settings.text: The first bolt went in at the family shop in Waterloo. Then came nights and weekends stolen from work and family, sketches redrawn a thousand times, and a shop the whole family turned into a second home.

settings.title: Nothing off the shelf
settings.text: A Cat 3208 V8 in reverse flow, a setup you won’t find on any other tractor on the track. 636 cubic inches stock, built out to 680. Nothing about it was quick. Full spec sheet

settings.title: How it got built
settings.subtitle: Twelve years, one family shop, zero shortcuts.
settings.carousel_label: Chapters 01 to 03, scroll sideways for more

settings.heading: Twelve years
settings.text: The sketches, the nights and weekends, the family shop, and the night the engine fired and lightning struck. The whole story, the way we tell it.

settings.pre: Then, in 2026, the moment came. Chris stood in the shop and turned the engine over for the first time.
settings.post: Some would call it a coincidence. We call it a sign. From that night on, there was no doubt about what we had built.
settings.caption: Sound on. This is how it sounded in the shop when the engine fired and the lightning hit.

settings.title: The pull didn’t finish that day
settings.text_1: The first pull didn’t go the way anyone hoped. A small, unexpected issue came up and the run ended before it should have. It was a disappointing day.
settings.text_2: But getting the tractor onto a real track at all, twelve years after the idea and six years of building it with our own hands, was already something to be proud of. The story was just getting started.
settings.foot_text: On the NTPA & PPL Badger State circuits. Every run goes in the Pit Log.

settings.label: Met
settings.value: at a pull in the Netherlands

settings.bro_lede: “The Evil One” has a brother across the ocean: Diesel Ross, a Pro Stock tractor in Europe owned by Gert Stessens from Belgium.
settings.bro_text: We met Gert at a pull in the Netherlands. Between the look of the two tractors and the friendship between Gert and Chris, “The Evil One” and Diesel Ross are considered tractor brothers.
settings.song_caption: The song “The Evil One” rolls up to the line with. Turn it up before the next pull.
settings.pl_sub: What plays in the trailer and the pit
